core: Colony-stimulating factor control of myeloid cells
qualifier: monocyte-macrophage expansion and survival in bone marrow
name: Colony-stimulating factor-driven monocyte-macrophage expansion in bone marrow
rationale: Members cover M-CSF/GM-CSF/G-CSF production and signalling driving monocyte, macrophage and dendritic cell differentiation plus bone marrow cell proliferation and survival, unlike the granulopoiesis, osteoclast and bone marrow development neighbours.

qualifier: follicle and oocyte maturation through ovulation and luteolysis
name: Ovarian follicle and oocyte maturation through ovulation and luteolysis
rationale: All members concern the female ovarian cycle (antral follicle growth, oocyte maturation, ovulation, luteinization, luteolysis, estrous cycle), whereas confusables centre on testis development and gonadotropin/FSH signalling.

name: L-amino acid catabolism, chiefly histidine and threonine degradation
rationale: Members are amino acid (and related amide/pyrimidine nucleobase) catabolic processes, with histidine and threonine breakdown distinguishing it from the glycine/proline and phenylalanine/tyrosine neighbours.

name: Potassium channels shaping cardiac action potential phases
rationale: Members are the cardiac action potential phases 1-4 and the Kv, Kir and two-pore K+ channels that set repolarisation and resting potential, unlike neighbours about conduction-system regions or non-cardiac K+ channels.

name: Podocyte development and brush-border microvillus assembly
rationale: Members cover glomerular podocyte development (nephrin, basement membrane, migration, albumin handling) and microvillus/brush border assembly, distinguishing it from mesangial/endothelial glomerulus and general epithelial polarity neighbours.

name: Microtubule-based transport of neuronal cargo, mitochondria and endolysosomes
rationale: Members describe motor-driven transport along microtubules/actin of synaptic and dense core vesicles, mitochondria and endolysosomal organelles (with their size control), unlike neighbours on kinesins, tubulin modification, microtubule severing or lysosome fusion.

name: Inorganic anion transporters and tooth mineralization
rationale: Members combine SLC4/SLC26 bicarbonate, sulfate, iodide, oxalate and phosphate transport (and their diseases) with enamel/dentin mineralization and tooth eruption, unlike neighbours on proton/pH control and sodium-phosphate cotransport.

name: CD28-family costimulation and co-inhibition of T cell activation
rationale: All members concern CD28-dependent costimulatory signalling and CTLA4/BTLA co-inhibition tuning TCR signalling, whereas neighbours cover proximal TCR/BCR signalling and B cell activation.

name: Activation of JNK stress-activated kinase cascade
rationale: All three members are positive regulation of JNK/stress-activated protein kinase signalling, distinct from the NOD, inflammasome and TLR/IKK neighbours.

qualifier: TGF-beta receptor/SMAD cancer mutants, RUNX3 and Hippo-YAP
name: Tumour-suppressive TGF-beta, RUNX3 and Hippo-YAP growth control
rationale: Members are cancer mutants of TGF-beta receptors/SMADs and TCF7L2, RUNX3 target regulation, Hippo-YAP/TAZ and cell-density sensing, i.e. tumour-suppressive growth control, whereas neighbours are wild-type TGF-beta/TGFBR3/activin signalling.

name: DNA replication initiation and replication-associated genome maintenance
rationale: Members cover replication initiation, mitotic DNA replication, intra-S checkpoint, break-induced replication and recombination intermediate resolution, unlike the broad mitotic cell cycle, telomere and cohesin neighbours.

qualifier: protein import plus fatty acid beta-oxidation
name: Peroxisomal protein import and fatty acid beta-oxidation
rationale: Members are peroxisomal protein targeting/import, fission and peroxisomal alpha/beta-oxidation of very long, long and medium-chain fatty acyl-CoAs, unlike neighbours on fatty acid elongation, plasmalogen and wax synthesis.

name: Spermine and spermidine interconversion and oxidation
rationale: All members concern spermine/spermidine metabolism and their oxidative interconversion by polyamine oxidases, whereas the nearest neighbour covers ODC-driven putrescine synthesis and polyamine transport.

name: Integrin-dependent leukocyte adhesion and extravasation through endothelium
rationale: Members regulate integrin activation, leukocyte adhesion to vascular endothelium, diapedesis and neutrophil/T cell extravasation, unlike neighbours on endothelial shear stress, PECAM1 and monocyte activation.

qualifier: regulation of electron transport and oxidative phosphorylation
name: Regulation of mitochondrial electron transport and oxidative phosphorylation
rationale: Members regulate (mostly restrain) oxidative phosphorylation, complex I electron transport and respiration-linked ROS production, whereas neighbours concern oxidative-stress and hypoxia-induced cell death.

qualifier: axo-dendritic synaptic cargo and dense core vesicles
name: Axo-dendritic transport of synaptic cargo and dense core vesicles
rationale: All members are long-range transport of neuronal cargo (dense core vesicles, synaptic vesicles, receptor complexes, presynaptic proteins), lacking the mitochondrial/organelle transport and synaptic vesicle cycling of neighbours.

qualifier: sarcoplasmic reticulum reuptake and sodium-calcium exchange
name: Cardiac sarcoplasmic reticulum calcium reuptake and sodium-calcium exchange
rationale: Members concern lowering cytosolic Ca2+ by SERCA-mediated SR uptake and Na+/Ca2+ exchange, controlling cardiac relaxation and contractile force, whereas neighbours centre on ryanodine-receptor calcium release and heart rate.

qualifier: B cell antibody diversification and viral restriction
name: Cytidine deamination in antibody diversification and antiviral restriction
rationale: Members cover AID/APOBEC cytidine deamination for somatic hypermutation, V(D)J-linked B cell development, RNA editing and restriction of viral replication, unlike general DNA repair and demethylation neighbours.

name: Ephrin and Sema3A repulsive axon guidance and remodeling
rationale: Members are ephrin and Sema3A-plexin repulsion, growth cone collapse, fasciculation, branching and pruning, distinguishing it from L1/NCAM, Sema4D, netrin and collateral sprouting neighbours.

core: Negative regulation of membrane ion flux
qualifier: calcium and potassium currents and excitability
name: Suppression of membrane calcium and potassium flux and excitability
rationale: Most members inhibit plasma-membrane calcium and potassium transport and action potentials (with channel targeting and muscle cell apoptosis as minor members), unlike neighbours on cardiac K+ channel phases, sodium transport or SERCA.

name: Ligand binding to FGFR1 and FGFR2 b/c isoforms
rationale: All four members are ligand binding and activation of FGFR1 and FGFR2 IIIb/IIIc splice isoforms, whereas neighbours cover FGFR3/4 binding, downstream FRS/SHC/PLC cascades and mutant receptors.

name: Megakaryocyte differentiation and platelet formation
rationale: Members concern megakaryocyte differentiation, development and platelet morphogenesis (with suppression of the erythroid fate), unlike erythroid, HSC and myeloid progenitor neighbours.

name: Monoamine neurotransmitter degradation by MAO and COMT
rationale: All members describe oxidative deamination and methylation of dopamine, serotonin and other biogenic amines, whereas neighbours concern monoamine transport, uptake and biosynthesis.

name: Origin licensing by pre-replicative complex assembly
rationale: Members are ORC/CDC6 loading, pre-RC activation and its E2F-dependent inhibition, i.e. replication origin licensing, distinct from E2F transcription and replication initiation/checkpoint neighbours.

Members mix responses to ethanol, ether, anesthetics, antibiotics and drugs with agmatine/NO and amine metabolism, hypoxia and oxidative-stress responses and developmental apoptosis, sharing no single nameable biological process.
